tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground and the sticky header. Plain white in light, cool near-black in dark. Never tinted warm.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: The one quiet fill: code panels, table heads, the install panels' header bars, a selected row, an input group. A surface sits on color-bg with a 1px color-divider edge, not a shadow.

tokens.name: color-surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill on color-surface rows and secondary buttons; the track of a segmented control; the neutral tag ground.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, table values, the wordmark. 17.5:1 on color-bg light, 15.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: ledes under a section, captions under a panel, table heads, cost lines, nav links at rest. 8.0:1 on color-bg light, 8.9:1 dark; holds on every surface.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: The quietest readable text: provenance lines, small print, the requirements note. 5.6:1 on color-bg light (4.9:1 on color-surface-2), 6.3:1 dark. Nothing lighter is used for text.

tokens.name: color-divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section rules, table rows, panel edges, the header's bottom edge. Structural only; never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: The stronger rule: under a table head, around the flow strip and command panels, between flow-strip cells.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: secondary buttons, inputs, checkboxes, radio rings, diagram node outlines. 3.4:1 on color-bg light, 4.1:1 dark, so a control reads as a control.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Cobalt, the one brand hue. Primary button fill, links, eyebrows, the selected tab underline, focus rings, the checkpoint block in the flow strip and the human node in a diagram. 6.0:1 on color-bg light and 5.3:1 on color-accent-subtle; 6.8:1 on color-bg dark.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and link, hover.

tokens.name: color-accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button, pressed.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a color-accent fill: the primary button label, the checkpoint block, a filled human node. White on the light accent (6.0:1); near-black on the lighter dark-theme accent (6.8:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: a callout, the current step in the state machine, a selected table row, an accent tag.

tokens.name: color-accent-border
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of a color-accent-subtle callout or accent tag.

tokens.name: color-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Text on color-accent-subtle: callout titles, accent tag labels, the label of the current state-machine node (9.3:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-halt
tokens.usage: Semantic, never decorative: a halt. Outlines and labels halt nodes in a diagram, the halt tag, a SHIP HALTED banner. It never means 'bad' anywhere else and never colours a number. 5.7:1 on color-bg light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-halt-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a highlighted halt node (when its row in the halts table is selected) and of the halt tag.

tokens.name: color-halt-border
tokens.usage: Edge of the halt tag on color-halt-subtle.

tokens.name: color-on-halt
tokens.usage: Text on a solid color-halt fill (5.7:1 light). Rare: a halt is usually an outline.

tokens.name: color-neutral-100
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 100. Same value as light color-surface.

tokens.name: color-neutral-200
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 200.

tokens.name: color-neutral-300
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 300. The neutral block on the cover.

tokens.name: color-neutral-400
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 400.

tokens.name: color-neutral-500
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 500.

tokens.name: color-neutral-600
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 600.

tokens.name: color-neutral-700
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 700.

tokens.name: color-neutral-800
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 800.

tokens.name: color-neutral-900
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp, step 900. The dialog backdrop at 48%.

tokens.name: color-accent-100
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 100.

tokens.name: color-accent-200
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 200. The tint block on the cover.

tokens.name: color-accent-300
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 300.

tokens.name: color-accent-400
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 400.

tokens.name: color-accent-500
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 500.

tokens.name: color-accent-600
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 600. The light-theme color-accent.

tokens.name: color-accent-700
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 700.

tokens.name: color-accent-800
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 800.

tokens.name: color-accent-900
tokens.usage: Cobalt ramp, step 900.

tokens.name: term-ground
tokens.usage: Output panels and docs terminal frames. Near-black in both themes; in dark it steps up from color-bg so the panel still reads as a panel.

tokens.name: term-text
tokens.usage: Default text in an output panel: CLI output and the $ command lines (13.4:1 on term-ground light, 12.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: The page's own narration in a panel (lines starting #), skipped checks, the LEAN SHIP line (6.3:1, 5.9:1).

tokens.name: term-accent
tokens.usage: The two or three lines in a panel that matter: SHIP COMPLETE, the commit, GATE lines (7.9:1, 7.3:1).

tokens.name: term-halt
tokens.usage: SHIP HALTED and RUN NOT RECONSTRUCTABLE lines in a panel (8.1:1, 7.5:1). Halts only.

tokens.name: poster-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of exported images (the social card, docs boards) from this revision on. The PNGs under assets/ were exported in the previous warm palette and are due for re-export.

tokens.name: poster-ink
tokens.usage: Headline ink on poster-ground (17.5:1).

tokens.name: poster-accent
tokens.usage: The cobalt square before the wordmark and the checkpoint block on an exported poster (6.0:1 on poster-ground).

tokens.name: poster-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text inside the poster's filled block (6.0:1).

tokens.name: poster-grey
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and mono labels on poster-ground (8.0:1).

tokens.name: report-ground
tokens.usage: Report page ground behind the sheet (--ground in lib/report-html.mjs). The report palette is separate from the brand palette and never mixes with it.

tokens.name: report-panel
tokens.usage: The report sheet (--panel). All report text sits on it.

tokens.name: report-ink
tokens.usage: Report text and every reading, measured or absent, on report-panel (16.5:1 light, 15.6:1 dark) (--ink).

tokens.name: report-ink2
tokens.usage: Report labels, definitions, bases and section heads on report-panel (5.6:1 light, 7.2:1 dark) (--ink2).

tokens.name: report-rule
tokens.usage: The heavier report hairline: the rule under the header, the indicator table head, and the soft bar of an exit distribution (--rule).

tokens.name: report-hair
tokens.usage: The lighter report hairline between corpus blocks and indicator rows, and the track of a proportion mark (--hair).

tokens.name: report-mark
tokens.usage: The fill of a proportion mark or distribution bar (--mark). It encodes quantity only. It never means good, and nothing in the report is coloured to mean bad. 5.0:1 on report-panel light, 9.6:1 dark.

families.heading: "IBM Plex Sans", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.report-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The page headline, once. Fluid: clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 56px), measure capped at 18ch. 24px of clear space before the lede at every width.

styles.name: display-section
styles.sample: How many decisions the model is not allowed to make.
styles.usage: One per tab or long page: the tab headline. clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 40px), measure 24ch.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: A section subhead under an eyebrow. A plain label of what is under it, at 500: not a second heavy claim.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Row titles, disclosure summaries, column labels, the line inside the checkpoint block (16px there).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: A figure in the proof row, tabular numerals, always over a caption that says what was counted. No colour, arrow or unit.

styles.name: pullquote
styles.usage: A quoted line from the project's docs, under a 24×2px color-accent lead rule. Never a box, never a left border.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The stylesheet's bare h1 to h6, for long-form pages that are not the landing page. Sentence case at every level.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Stylesheet h2.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Stylesheet h3.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Stylesheet h4; also the dialog title.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Stylesheet h5.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Stylesheet h6. Sentence case; no uppercase transform.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Spec a change, read it, then ship it start-to-commit with parallel agents.
styles.usage: The paragraph under the hero headline, in color-text-soft. Measure 60ch.

styles.name: body-page
styles.usage: Running copy on the landing page. Measure 60 to 70ch, text-wrap: pretty.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base body size for app-like pages, table-adjacent prose, disclosure bodies.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, buttons, inputs, nav links, footer links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions under a film or panel, provenance lines, small print. The smallest text size in the system.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The label above a subhead, a panel or a footer column: sentence case, color-accent, no tracking, no uppercase. Two to six words.

styles.name: mono-wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark: capitals, color-text, after a 10px color-accent square. The one place uppercase tracking is used.

styles.name: mono-command
styles.usage: A command name in the flow strip or a timeline step. Lower case, exactly as typed.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Code panels and listings on color-surface. Inline code in a sentence is this family at 0.9em, no fill, no border.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: The caption line above an output panel (what printed it), mono values in tables, figure lines under a film.

styles.name: mono-tag
styles.usage: Text in a tag that names a kind: skill, workflow, experimental, strict. Lower case.

styles.name: term
styles.usage: Text in an on-screen output panel. Long lines scroll inside the panel; they never wrap the page.

styles.name: term-board
styles.usage: Text in a terminal frame on a 1600px docs artboard (shown at half width, so never under 22px).

styles.name: term-caption
styles.usage: The one-line caption above a terminal frame on a docs artboard, color-text-soft on poster-ground.

styles.name: report-title
styles.usage: The report h1. System sans at 500: the report loads no font.

styles.name: report-heading
styles.usage: A corpus name (report h3). Indicator titles are 14.5px at the same weight.

styles.name: report-body
styles.usage: Report running text. Findings 13px, definitions and notes 12.5px.

styles.name: report-section
styles.sample: COVERAGE — WHAT THE CORPORA CAN AND CANNOT ANSWER
styles.usage: Report h2 and the kicker: uppercase, report-ink2. Column heads use 10px at 0.13em.

styles.name: report-reading
styles.usage: An indicator's headline. A number and an absence word take exactly this style: same face, size, weight and colour. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: report-basis
styles.usage: The denominator under a reading, or the reason there is none. report-ink2.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; the gap between a caption and the panel it names.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; tag padding; the gap between an eyebrow and its subhead.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (with space-2 vertical); paragraph spacing in tight blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; flow-strip cell padding; the phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Callout padding; the gap between columns of a two-column block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The desktop page gutter; the gap between a subhead and the content under it; the gap under a hero headline.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between footer columns; between the pain rows on the Why tab.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between the hero's parts (strip, install, film, proof).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections of a tab, each opened by a 1px color-divider rule.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, segmented options.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code and output panels, the flow strip, tables in a bordered box, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and cards that float.

tokens.name: radius-terminal
tokens.usage: Terminal frames on docs artboards (12px at the 1600px artboard size, shown at half width).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The radio dot, and nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The selected option of a segmented control. Nothing on the landing page casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: A card or menu that floats over content.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: font-heading-weight
tokens.usage: Headlines, h1 to h6, row titles, eyebrows, primary labels. Body is 400, subheads and nav are 500, and nothing heavier than 600 is used.

tokens.name: font-medium-weight
tokens.usage: Section subheads (title-lg), buttons, nav links, numerals, tags.

layout.note: Grid values the landing page repeats. Recorded so a new page lands on the same grid.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: The content column, centred.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the content column; 16px under 640px.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The sticky header.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every rule and border: section rules, table rows, panel edges, control borders.

tokens.name: rule-active
tokens.usage: The selected tab's underline and the current node's outline in the state machine. The only 2px line.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and the segmented control share it, so they sit side by side.

revised.note: Enterprise revision: cool neutrals on white, cobalt accent, a semantic halt red, IBM Plex Sans and Plex Mono, 600-weight headings, sentence-case eyebrows, 4px corners, 1px rules. Replaces the warm paper, vermilion, Archivo 800 and uppercase mono kickers of the first sync. The report palette is unchanged.
